title: Add fetchInvoices to the billing API client
description: The new invoices tab needs the customer's invoices; follows the existing client helpers.

expected_issues.description: `fetch` does not reject on HTTP errors and `res.ok` is never checked, so a 401/404/500 error body is parsed as data and `body.invoices.map` throws a confusing TypeError (or `res.json()` throws on an HTML error page). Check `res.ok` and throw `ApiError` like `fetchCustomer`.
